report.title: Service Center Report
report.ask.1: Experience with this specific chipset and storage class.
report.ask.2: Infrared soldering station (not a heat gun) with a stencil matching this UFS/eMMC package.
report.ask.4: Readiness to replace UFS/CPU if chip-off fails (price upfront).
report.ask.5: If possible — ISP instead of chip-off (less risk, but often unavailable on new Xiaomi).

lock.review.title: Relock: evidence required
lock.review.body:
This toolkit cannot establish that relocking is safe. It does not generate lock or erase scripts.

The unlock method or device profile alone is insufficient. Booting Android while unlocked, matching partition sizes and saving a diagnostic snapshot do not verify the signed boot chain or provide a full partition backup.

Before considering relocking, establish the exact hardware model and sales region, the origin and authenticity of the complete stock firmware, rollback compatibility and the applicable manufacturer procedure. Modified images (including xiaomi.eu, TWRP and Magisk) are not evidence of compatible stock firmware.

The pandora incident followed erasing efisp and locking. The retained boot log reports no bootable slot; it does not establish the complete cause. A repair account is not a universal relock recipe. Neither clean_all_and_lock nor a locked state guarantees Play Protect certification.

Do not repeat the historical commands as a repair procedure. Keep a backup outside the phone. Unknown or conflicting evidence means stop and obtain model/firmware-specific verification.
